question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Her ________ in the face of adversity was truly commendable and inspired everyone around her.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Resilience**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Resilience"** means the ability to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness or the capacity to withstand adversity and bounce back. (लचीलापन, दृढ़ता)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite facing numerous setbacks, she showed incredible resilience and continued to work towards her goal.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "Her ________ in the face of adversity was truly commendable and inspired everyone around her," the word "resilience" perfectly fits because it indicates the admirable ability to stay strong and overcome hardships.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Resilience**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cowardice** (कायरता): Lack of bravery or courage in facing danger, difficulty, or pain.

 
 
• **Example:** His cowardice in not standing up for his friends was disappointing.
 
 
 
• **Indifference** (उदासीनता): Lack of interest, concern, or sympathy for something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** Her indifference to the plight of the homeless was shocking.
 
 
 
• **Negligence** (लापरवाही): Failure to take proper care in doing something, often leading to undesirable outcomes.
 
 
• **Example:** The accident was caused by his negligence in following traffic rules.
 
 

37:Tab2,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**
